ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark/black pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white field covering the central surface. Continuous low-intensity irregular banding along the trailing edge and tips. Small discrete dark focal spots mapped to the lower-left and lower-central quadrants near the waterline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 95 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations spanning the entire trailing edge. Right lobe edge exhibits higher pixel-amplitude peaks (saw-tooth pattern) compared to the left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Gentle convex curve extending from the median notch to the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters on the lower-left and central white ventral field. High-contrast white clusters present on the dark distal tips corresponding to colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine-scale dark linear disruptions visible on the lower-left quadrant of the white ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple dark pigmented spots on the white ventral field; pronounced irregular jagged topography on the right-hand trailing edge.
